Commentary.Commentary: So that is it from this Test. Ireland showed great fight and they did prove they belong among the elites. Pakistan on the other hand, still have a lot of work to be done as the test they face ahead won't be easy. They will now be facing England in this month which can turn out to be another cracking contest. For now, you can switch tabs to the Indian T20 League game between Kolkata and Rajasthan. Goodbye and cheers!

Not many times do you see a player from the losing side is awarded the Man of the Match, but such was the performance of Kevin O'Brien. He was Ireland's highest-scorer in both the innings but his ton in the second, not only helped Ireland avoid an innings defeat but also made them believe they could have won it.

Chasing 160, Pakistan lost 3 wickets quickly and at that time Ireland looked like they would go on to win their first Test. But an outstanding partnership between Babar Azam and Imam saw them weathering the storm and taking Pakistan over the line.

310 was the deficit Ireland had to wipe off and they fell way short. They lost a flurry of wickets at the start with no top order batsman getting into double figures. Kevin O'Brien did fight hard but Ireland were bundled out for a paltry total with Abbas and Shadab sharing 7 wickets amongst them. After the follow-on being enforced, the home side showed more character with the bat. Their opening pair got them off to a good start but their middle order stumbled. However, Kevin O'Brien who scored a ton, along with Thompson first and then Kane, set a difficult target of 160.

A brilliant Test match is what we witnessed. It ended as everybody expected with Pakistan coming out victorious. But, the Irish did give them a run for their money. After the first day was washed off, the home side won the toss on the second day and elected to bowl. They had Pakistan on the mat at 159/6 via some exceptional bowling from Murtagh, but could not capitalize. Some poor fielding and wayward bowling saw Shadab Khan and another debutant, Faheem Ashraf, build a 117-run stand which took Pakistan to a respectable first innings score.

Imam-ul-Haq, a debut to remember for the young lad. He has batted through and ensured his side finish on the right side. He walks off to a standing ovation from his teammates. They required another 108 runs after the lunch break and they toppled those runs off with ease, courtesy a 126-run stand between Babar (who was dropped by Balbirnie) and Imam. They did lose two wickets towards the end but Shadab Khan then came in and made sure there were no further hiccups.

That is it! It is Imam, the youngster, who hits the winning runs on his debut. Not in convincing fashion but he won't care. This is an inswinger on off, Imam tries to defend it but it goes off the inner half through backward square leg for a brace. All smiles in the Pakistan camp as THEY WIN BY 5 WICKETS!
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Fuller on off, it is driven towards the man at covers for a run.
Width on offer outside off, Shadab does not go chasing after it and leaves it.
Works it with the angle through mid-wicket. The fielder there fails to collect the ball and the batsmen run two. Three to win.
Length around middle, it is defended.
The batsman manages only a bottom edge on that one.
Good length on middle, the batsman taps it towards mid on for a run. Just 5 more needed now.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Short and outside off, it is cut through backward point for a run.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Another ball angling across the batsman. He shoulders arms to it.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Good length on off, kept out.
A yorker on middle, the batsman digs it out towards covers for a run.
Another ball outside off, it is left alone.
Wide outside off, left alone.
Good length on off, defended.
The away swinger from outside off, Shadab has a feel for it and gets beaten.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Length around off, kept out.
Shadab Khan walks out to the middle.

OUT! Another wicket for Ireland. But all this is coming a little too late. This is bowled on a length and around middle, Sarfraz hops and tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. The players appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Ahmed walks back dejected.
FOUR! The runs required are below 10 now! On a length around off, Sarfraz rocks back and guides it through backward point for a boundary.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
And again. Ends the over with another lovely away swinger. Imam gets sucked into it. Looks to drive that but misses it. Maiden over.
Ripper from Kane! Drifting in from round the wicket angle, just moves away a wee bit. Imam lunges forward to defend that but misses and the ball whistles past the outside edge.
Shortish delivery, angling in from outside off, defended down the track.
Good length ball outside off, swings further away. No shot offered by Imam-ul-Haq.
Fuller length ball, swings away late, Imam keeps his bat high and lets it go.
Dishes out a fullish delivery on the stumps, Imam plays a drive straight back to the bowler.
Tyrone Kane is back on.
BEATEN! That has swung like a banana! On a length and around off, it shapes away. Sarfraz tries to defend but gets beaten.
Back of a length on off, it is tapped towards covers. No ball signaled by the umpire as the bowler oversteps.
An outswinger outside off, the batsman shoulders arms to it.
On a length around off, the batsman tries to defend but gets it off the inner half towards mid-wicket for a run.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.

Good length outside off, the batsman first thinks of playing at it but then tries to pull his bat out. He is late in doing so but luckily for him it goes off the bottom edge through backward point for a brace.
The ball is too wide on the off side for the batsman to make any contact.
On a length around off, it is defended onto the front foot.
On a length around off, it is defended onto the front foot.
Fullish on off, it is eased to mid on.
FOUR! Short and wide and Sarfraz pounces on it. He cuts it through point and the ball races away. Four boundaries away now Pakistan.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Good length on off, defended.
Fuller on middle, driven to mid on.
Length again and kept out.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Back of a length on off, kept out.
A huge appeal! On a length around off, this one comes back in. Imam tries to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads. The players appeal but the umpire shakes his head.
Sarfraz Ahmed is the next man in.

OUT! A run out just when Pakistan are inching closer to victory. Well, Ireland will rejoice. This is bowled on a length around off, Imam taps it towards covers and sets off for a run. Azam obliges but seeing Balbirnie get to the ball quickly, Imam sends him back. Azam is halfway down the track as he tries to turn and get back. Andy passes it to the bowler who collects it and takes the bails off. The players appeal and the umpire takes it upstairs. Replays find Babar short. He walks back and that ends the 126-run stand. However, Azam has done his job but he will be disappointed as he fails to take his team over the line. 20 more needed.
An appeal for a run out has been taken upstairs. Azam is the man in question. Ireland are very confident.
Wide outside off again, the batsman makes a leave.
Goes fuller in length on off, Azam mistimes it to the man at mid on.
Back of a length on off, it is pushed to covers.
Third leave in a row! Outside off, the batsman need not play at those.
Another leave! Pakistan are in no rush here. Outside off, left alone.
Another good length ball outside off, left alone.
Down the leg side, the batsman misses the flick.
Angles it on the pads, Babar tries to flick but gets an inside edge onto his pads. The ball rolls towards square leg and the batsmen take a run.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Fuller and on off, it swings away further. The batsman lets it be.
Fullish outside off, the batsman goes for a booming drive but gets an inside edge onto the leg side. The batsmen complete a run. Just one more than 20 needed.
Bangs it in short on middle, Imam off the back foot defends it onto the ground.
Good length on off, the batsman defends it solidly.
Shortens his length a touch outside off, Azam off the back foot pushes it to covers.
Another ball in the fifth stump channel. Azam does not feel like playing those.
A gentle away swinger outside off, Azam makes a leave.
Good length on middle, it is defended onto the ground.
Shortish and outside off, it is cut through point. They have a man in the deep who runs across to his right and keeps it down to two.
Tim Murtagh is back on.
Another outswinger wide outside off, the batsman makes another leave.
Goes fuller this time outside off, Imam strokes it off the middle but finds the man at covers.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Wide outside off, Imam lets it be.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Very wide outside off, the batsman leaves it alone.
Fullish and on off, it is mistimed to the man at mid off.
Fuller on the pads, Azam works it through square leg and bags a brace. 24 more needed.
Shortish on middle, Azam tucks it to the man at mid on.
Deduct three more from the runs required as Imam strokes it through mid on and the batsmen run three.
Back of a length on off, Azam taps it towards the off side and the batsmen take a quick run.
Short again down the leg side, Azam lets it be.
Short ball aimed at the rib cage of the batsman. Babar misses the flick. Rankin has once again over stepped and a no ball is signaled.
Flicks it off his pads to fine leg for an easy single.
Widish delivery from Thompson, Azam doesn't play at it.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.

FOUR! Fifty to Babar Azam, his fifth in Test matches. This has been a good knock from the stylish right-hander and he is making the Irish players pay for the opportunity missed earlier in the session. Shortish delivery on the stumps, he gets on top of the bounce and swipes it through mid-wicket. Back-to-back boundaries. Thompson oversteps, so five more added to the total.
FOUR! Gorgeous cover drive. Bowls a fullish delivery outside off, Babar leans into the drive and caresses it through the covers for a boundary.
Fuller length ball outside off, Babar shoulders arms to it.
Fuller length ball, Babar plays a drive through the line. The fielder at point dives to his right and makes a good stop.
Length ball outside off, Imam leaves it all alone.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
Bumper from Rankin, Babar moves across and pulls to fine leg for a single.
No ball! Rankin oversteps and needs to reload. Goes for an effort ball and in the process he lands his front foot outside the crease. Full ball and Babar defends it out.
Fuller length ball, defended down the track.

Babar is finding it tough to negotiate the angle that Rankin is generating from round the wicket. The right-hander gets a leading edge as he looks to defend of the back foot, the ball rolls to point. The fielder there fumbles and concedes a couple.
Angling across from round the wicket, Babar is squared up. The ball whizzes past the outside edge.

Appeal for an LBW but it soon dies. Fuller length ball, angling in and nips back too, Imam lunges forward to defend that. He gets rapped on the pads. Replays are in and they show there is an inside edge.
Bowls it full on off, driven to the mid off region.
Good length ball, angling in, the left-hander decides to shoulder arms.
Harmless delivery outside off, left alone.
An innocuous delivery from Thompson outside off, the batsman lets it go.
Serves up a fullish delivery outside and Imam leaves it all alone.
Stuart Thompson is back into the attack.
Drifting it well down the leg side and the batsman decides to leave it.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks under the bouncer at the last moment.
No ball! Rankin serves a bumper which loops over Babar Azam. Rankin oversteps and a no ball is the signal from the umpire.

Rankin delivers from round the wicket. On the pads and Babar whips it past to the right of the man at mid on. They take a couple. Brings up the 100-run partnership with Imam. These two have played with a lot of responsibility and have taken Pakistan to a safer shore. Ireland ruing the chance missed by Andy just at the start of this session.
No shot offered by Babar. He moves across expecting to leave a delivery heading down leg but the ball just nips back enough and hits him on the thigh pad.
Full pitched delivery on the leg stump line. Babar pushes it to mid on.
Opens the face of the bat and dabs it to the man at cover-point.
Short of a length ball, Imam works it past the man at mid-wicket for a couple more.
Well-timed straight drive from Imam, but the fielder at mid off rushes to his left and blocks it.
Length ball, angling across. Imam doesn't play at it.
Did that just stop on Babar? Maybe, yes it did. Babar is early into the drive and mistimes it to the left of mid off. Single taken. Pakistan need 50 more to cross the line.
Stands tall and punches it through covers for a single.
Fuller length ball on the off stump line, it swings away just a little and beats Imam who is looking to play the drive on the rise.
More runs. Too full from Rankin and it gets drilled through the covers by Imam. They collect another three runs.
Half-volley on the pads and Azam whips it to the right of mid on. Three runs completed.
Short and outside off, Azam stands tall and looks to cut. He mistimes it on the off side.
Slips it down the leg side. Azam doesn't play at it.
Short of a length ball on the stumps, Azam gets right behind it and blocks.
Wide delivery down the leg side from Rankin, Azam looks to glance that but he fails to connect.

Massive shout for LBW from the Irish fielders but that is too high. Short of a length ball, dips in late. Imam looks to leave it but gets hit high on the pads. The appeal isn't entertained by the umpire.
Bowls it closer to the off peg. Imam judges it well, covers his stumps and decides to leave it.
Length ball on middle and leg, defended down the track.
On a length outside off, angling across. Imam doesn't play at it.

FOUR! Creamed through the covers. Lovely timing from Imam. A low full toss from Kane is drilled through the covers. 100 up for Pakistan, they need 58 more and these two are making it look ridiculously easy.
Bowls a half-volley outside off and Imam goes really hard at that one but he mistimes it to mid off.

FOUR! Plays a square cut and finds the gap to perfection. On a length outside off from the Irish pacer and Babar slaps it in front of point. The ball speeds away to the boundary. Pakistan need 62 more.
Shortish delivery from Murtagh, Babar pushes it to the fielder at short extra cover.
Pushes it to the right of the fielder at mid off. They steal a quick single.
Bowls it fuller on the stumps. Defended by Imam.
Good length ball outside off. Left alone by the batsman.
Fuller length ball outside off, Imam punches it to the man at mid off.
Length ball outside off, Azam doesn't play at it.

Fifty to Imam-ul-Haq, his maiden in Test cricket on debut. He becomes the fourth debutant in this match to score a fifty. This has been a good knock under pressure and he has delivered when his team needed it the most. Full delivery on the stumps, moves across and whips it to the left of mid on. Three runs added to the total.
Bowls it full down the leg side, the batsman looks to glance that but he fails to connect.
Another leave from Imam-ul-Haq. He is playing with a lot of patience.
Good length ball wider of the off stump. Left alone by the batsman.
Fuller length ball on off, Imam plays a square drive but he finds the man at cover-point.
Tyrone Kane is back into the attack.
Short of a length ball outside off, Babar shoulders arms to it.
FOUR! Fine shot. Freebie on the pads and Babar makes it count. He goes right back and whips it nicely through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Babar lunges on the front foot and blocks it solidly.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Plays a drive to mid off but finds the fielder.
Fuller length ball on off, Babar plays a defensive stroke.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Width on offer and Imam cuts it hard to deep point. Single taken.
Angling into the pads and Babar knocks it behind the wicket on the leg side for a run.
FOUR! Neatly played by Babar. Rankin serves up a fullish delivery which is off target. Azam whips it off his pads in front of square on the leg side for a boundary.
Good length ball outside off, Babar goes across and leaves it all alone.

Direct hit at the bowler's end but Imam is well in. Short of a length ball, he taps it on the leg side and calls for a quick single. The fielder is quickly on to the ball and has a shy. He hits the stumps but Imam makes it safely as he set off quickly without hesitating.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.

Babar is receiving some treatment after getting hit on the knuckles. He should be fine though. Also, the dark clouds are starting to creep in and Pakistan will now have to step on the gas here as it looks like it could rain any moment. That is how dark it has got.
OUCH! That would be painful! Length ball, kisses the surface and jumps sharply. Babar lunges forward to defend that but he is hit on the gloves. He feels the pain straightaway.
FOUR! Shot! He is making full use of anything loose that is on offer from the Irish pacers. Short of a length ball outside off, Babar slaps it in front of point for a boundary.
Serves up a length delivery, Babar defends it back to the bowler.
Bowls a fuller length ball, which skids through. Babar is slightly late on it but manages to put bat to ball. Dabs it on the off side.
Fuller length ball, with a hint of away movement. Babar steps out and defends it solidly down the track.

Full delivery on the middle and leg stump line, Imam moves across and whips it to the left of mid on. They take two more. Runs are coming at a swift pace for Pakistan post lunch. Ireland need to strike quickly to stay in the game.
Length ball, angling across, Imam decides to leave it alone.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.

FOUR! Outside edge, which bisects the gap between third slip and gully! Fuller length ball on off, Imam lunges forward to play the cover drive. He gets a thick edge which luckily for him goes in the gap. Frustration written all over on the face of Rankin.
Good length ball on the stumps, the batsman stays back and pushes it to the cover region.
Murtagh starts with a delivery down the leg side, Imam looks to glance that but fails to put bat to ball.

FOUR! Superb shot! Babar gets right on top of the bounce and pulls it beautifully in front of square. Short ball, he plays a shot full of authority and earns a boundary for the effort. Brings up the 50-run partnership between the two. A vital stand for Pakistan as the two joined forces when they were in a spot of bother. Can they now stay there till the end?
Once again, the batsman covers the line of the delivery and blocks it.
Length ball on the stumps, Babar sits back and defends it to the cover region.
FOUR! Strong comeback from Babar, he gets a shortish delivery outside off. Rocks onto the back foot and cuts it through the covers for a boundary.

Dropped! Balbirnie is the culprit. Fullish delivery closer, to the off stump line, this one swings away after pitching. Babar lunges forward to defend that but he gets a thick outside edge to third slip. The fielder there goes low towards his left and tries to take it with one hand but can't hang on to it. A life for Babar. Is this the luck he needs to get back in form? He would surely want to make the most of the reprieve he has got.
Good length ball, punches it to the right of the man at mid off. Single taken.
Tim Murtagh to bowl from the other end.

Overpitched delivery from Rankin to end the over. Imam forces it down the track past his partner. Beats the man at mid on, they take three more. Profitable over for Pakistan, they have collected seven runs. Brings up the 50-run stand with Imam for the fourth wicket.
Short of a length ball, angling in. Dabbed on the leg side by the batsman.
Too wide from Rankin, the batsman decides to leave it all alone.
FOUR! Lovely cover drive, the positive footwork from Imam gets him to the pitch of the delivery. Caresses it through the covers. It is well-timed and the ball races to the boundary.
Delivers a pitched up delivery on off, the batsman pushes it gently back to the bowler.
Good length ball, angling in from outside off but still pretty wide. Imam lets it go.

We are back for the second session. Imam-ul-Haq and Babar Azam will continue their innings. The former will be on strike, he will be facing Boyd Rankin who will start the proceedings for Ireland in this session. Here we go...
... Day 5, Session 2 ...

So after the first session on Day 5, the game is evenly poised! Pakistan need another 108 runs and Ireland need another seven wickets. Defending 159, the Irish bowlers came out all guns blazing, making quick work of the Pakistan top order. At 14 for 3 it looked like we are going to witness another Pakistan collapse but the youngster, Imam-ul-Haq and Babar Azam absorbed all the pressure that was exerted and have done well to hang in out there. The away side would want the two to continue whereas the home side will hope for a few quick wickets after the break. The good news is that the rain gods haven't interfered and let's hope they show mercy and stay away for the rest of the match. Join us for the second session in a while.
Back of a length on off, Azam stands tall and defends it onto the ground. A maiden by Tim. THAT WILL BE LUNCH ON DAY 5!
Down the leg side, Azam misses the flick and it goes through to the keeper.
Another ball on a length on off, Azam defends it solidly.

Lovely bowling! That was so good that it was acknowledged by the batsman as well. On a length, it first angles into the batsman and then leaves him. Azam tries to keep it out off the back foot but gets beaten.
Another ball on a length around off, it is defended off the front foot.
Good length on middle, kept out.
Wide outside off, Imam makes another leave. So an over in which five leaves and a boundary was hit, comes to an end.
Drags his length back outside off, Imam lets it be.

FOUR! Width on offer yet again and Imam this time makes him pay. It is also a little too full and outside off. Imam slashes, gets it in the gap through covers for a boundary, 50 up for Pakistan and they still need another 108 runs.
This is even wider outside off, Imam leaves it. Thompson has to make the batsman play here.
Good length outside off, this one stays a touch low. Imam shoulders his arms to it.
The outswinger outside off. The batsman need not play at those.
Bowls it closer to the off pole this time. Azam lunges forward and blocks it out.
Lovely line and length! In the channel on uncertainty. Azam watchfully lets it be.
A little too short and width on offer. Azam off the back foot punches it through covers and bags a brace.
Back of a length around off, Imam tries to defend it but it squirts off the outside edge and goes through backward point for a run.
Angles this one across the batsman. Imam does not fiddle with it.
Fuller in length and tailing back in. Imam drives it back to the bowler.
Well stopped by Joyce at gully. Fuller length ball outside off, Babar plays a drive on the up, he gets a thick edge which is well stopped.
Good length ball, Babar gets right behind that one and defends it back to the bowler.
Drifting down leg, Imam goes across and taps it on the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Useful runs, this pair has added 30 runs so far and is getting Pakistan in a good position. Good length ball outside off, the batsman square cuts it behind point for a boundary.
That one almost rolls through the keeper. Did it hit a crack? It behaved like one. Hits the length on off and angles it across. Imam lets it go.
Good shot but doesn't find the gap. Width and Imam punches it. The fielder at backward point makes a good stop diving to his left.
Another lovely away swinger to end the over. Well left by Babar. Murtagh has bowled seven overs on the trot, will he get another one?
Fuller length ball on off, with a hint of away movement. The batsman covers his stumps by shuffling across and lets it go.
Shorter in length from Murtagh, pushed to the cover region.
Length ball, angling in from outside off, Babar goes back to defend that. He gets a bottom edge on to the pads.
Drifting on the leg stump line and the batsman works it through square leg for a single.

Iman punches off the back foot and hits it in the gap through the covers. They decide to take the second run. Direct hit is needed but the throw is bit off target and Imam makes it with a full length dive.
Easy leave from Babar Azam to end the over.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Innocuous delivery outside off, the batsman decides to leave it.
Spraying it well down the leg side. Azam doesn't need to play at those.
Fullish delivery in the channel outside off, the batsman doesn't play at that one.
Starts a spell with a pitched up delivery on the off stump line, Babar defends it off the front foot.
Stuart Thompson comes into the attack.
Babar lunges forward to defend that, the ball goes off the outer half and rolls to the right of the fielder at third slip. Single taken.
In the channel outside off, Babar sits back and shapes to cut that but doesn't play at it in the end.
Fullish delivery on off, Babar gets on the front foot and defends it solidly.
Azam charges down the track and puts Murtagh off his length. Defends it firmly down the track.
Length ball outside off, Babar doesn't offer a stroke to it.
Length ball outside off, Babar shuffles back and across as he defends it on the track.

FOUR! More runs, this has been a poor over from Rankin. He was all over the place and ends up conceding six runs. Ends his fifth over with a half volley on the pads and Imam glances it neatly away to the fine leg fence. Pakistan need 124 more!
Drops and takes a quick single. Good running, Pakistan pair needs to do this more to put pressure back on Ireland. Defends it wide of the man at backward point. They steal a run.
Easy pickings for Imam, hops across and flicks it off his pads to mid-wicket. He wanted the second run but decides against it. Seeing the throw coming in from the deep.
Good length ball outside off, Imam moves across and lets it through to the keeper.
Full pitched delivery on the stumps, Iman offers the straight bat and blocks it solidly down the track.
Rankin hits the deck hard and tries a bumper but it is too short and balloons over the batsman who has no troubles ducking under it.
Babar shuffles across and taps it wide of the fielder at short leg, who rushes to the ball and prevents the single.
Moving away from the stumps, seeing it wide, Babar decides to leave it.
Good length ball on off, Babar Azam takes few steps down the track and defends it right under his eyes.
Slipping on the pads, Azam moves across and whips it to deep square leg for a brace.
Imam plays a drive, goes off the outer half to point. They take a single.

Just falls short of Stirling. Is he standing too back?  Might be. Length ball on middle and leg, Imam had to play at that one, the ball moves away and catches the outside edge.  And it goes on the bounce to first slip.
Beaten comprehensively! Fullish delivery, seaming away a little from Babar Azam, who goes for the drive but fails to the cover the line of it and the ball goes whistling past the outside edge.
Fractionally too full from Rankin, Babar goes forward and plays a drive to mid off.
Full pitched delivery on off stump line, Azam covers the line of the delivery and defends.
Beauty from Rankin but equally well played by Imam. Yorker on middle, jams his bat down and blocks it on the off side. The young Pakistan pair steal a single.

FOUR! Good shot! That will boost his confidence to no limits! He gets a wide delivery and latches on to it in a flash. Jumps on the back foot, gets on top of the bounce and square cuts it between backward point and gully for a boundary.
Terrible delivery which allows Azam to get off strike. Full down the leg side, flicked away to fine leg for a single.
Length again on off, Imam defends it solidly. A good over this for Pakistan, 4 from it. They need to keep scoring, they can't be bogged down.
On a length and around off, leaves the southpaw after pitching. Imam tries to block it but for the second time in the over gets beaten.
Back of a length on off, it is kept out.
Another couple! This was well timed! Fuller and on off, Imam leans into it and drives it through mid off. It has not been hit well enough to reach the boundary but the batsmen run two.
Lovely use of the angle! This is on a length and around off. It slants away after pitching. Imam plays inside the line and gets beaten.
A little too full and on the pads, Imam works it through mid-wicket and bags a brace.
Fuller length ball on the off and middle stumps line. Azam defends it to covers.
Boyd Rankin for once misses his radar and bowls a delivery on the pads. Azam works it to deep square leg and collects couple.
A terrific yorker from Rankin, nearly sneaks through. Delivers in the blockhole, Azam jams his bat down in time and stops it.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
OUCH! That must have hurt! Short of a length ball on the stumps, moves away late and squares Azam, who is aiming to flick that but gets hit on the soft spot.
Bowls a full pitched delivery on the pads, Imam glances it nicely off his pads to fine leg for a single.
A massive shout for LBW but the umpire Nigel Llong is unmoved! Length ball, Babar gets forward to defend that, he gets hit above the knee roll which is what saved him there.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Outside edge from Azam, but it goes on the bounce to the man at third slip.
Babar Azam is the next man in.

OUT! And there goes another wicket! Murtagh goes through the defenses of Shafiq. A dream delivery. Ireland are well and truly on top! Shafiq departs without making much of a contribution. His lack of footwork proves to be his undoing. A length ball, nipping in sharply, Shafiq goes for a drive down the ground leaving a gap between bat and pad. The ball goes through the gap and cannons into the wickets. Pakistan still need 146 to win and they need a big partnership to make it there.
Fuller length ball on off, Shafiq plays a drive to the mid off region.

Gutsy leave from Shafiq! The ball misses the off stump by a whisker, Ireland nearly nipped out another one. Incoming delivery from Murtagh, Shafiq decides to leave it and after all it can be termed as a 'Safe leave'. Why? Because, Shafiq is still out there.
The batsman has played it to the point region. One run added to the total.
Well down the leg side and Shafiq doesn't play a shot to it.
Asad Shafiq is the new batsman.

OUT! Has Joyce taken it? He is claiming it and the Irish team is already celebrating. Pakistan have lost their second wicket in no time. Well, this game is tilting in the favor of the Irish now. A rising delivery, leaving the left-hander. Haris doesn't get on top of the bounce but still goes through with the punch as he tries to force it through the off side. Gets a thick edge towards gully where Joyce crouches low and grabs it inches above the ground. Oh wait! The umpire wants to check the front foot no ball but the TV umpire is happy and deems it a legal delivery. Haris Sohail continues his walk towards the pavilion.
Full pitched delivery on off, the batsman plays a drive through the line. The ball rolls to the mid off fielder.
Good length ball in the channel outside off, Sohail shoulders arms to it.
Short of  a length ball on the stumps, Haris drops it on the off side and calls for a quick single but his partner doesn't respond. There is just no room for a run out at this juncture.
Good comeback from Murtagh, adjusts his line and withdraws batsman on the front foot. Imam is beaten as he attempts a drive.
FOUR! Imam opens his account with a lovely flick shot! He gets a delivery on the pads and cashes on it. Goes right across and whips it to the left of mid on. The ball rolls away to the boundary.
A rising delivery from Murtagh, the batsman gets on top of the bounce and defends it to the point region.
Bowls a fullish delivery on off, Imam gets right behind it and defends it.
Not so convincing from Sohail, he gets forward but not to the pitch of the delivery as he drives it. Anyways, hits the gap through the covers and they take three runs.
Fires it full on off, Sohail stays back and defends it with the dead bat.
Good length ball outside and the batsman lets it go.
Covers the line of the delivery and defends off the back foot.
A loose shot from Imam, he goes chasing a wide delivery and nearly gets an outside edge.
Imam-ul-Haq gets on the front foot and plays a drive to the mid off region.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Short of a length ball outside off, Imam gets on the front foot and lets it go.
Boyd Rankin will bowl from the other.

FOUR! Aerial and there is a cry of catch it from the Irish players. Fuller length ball outside off, Sohail goes forward and plays a square drive uppishly past the man at backward point. The ball speeds away to the boundary.
Tentative start for Sohail, he stands tall and looks to work a straightish delivery from Murtagh but he gets pinged on the thigh pad.
Haris Sohail is the next man in.

OUT! Ireland draw first blood! This game isn't over, folks! What a delivery to nip out the Pakistan vice-captain and the hosts are over the moon. Tim comes in and lands it on a fuller length outside off, Ali without any feet movement tries to defend it. The ball shapes away a bit, takes the outside edge and goes into the bucket-like-hands of Paul Stirling at first slip who makes no mistake.
Wow, Ali once again uses his feet but seeing the length touch short. He decides to defend it.
Good shot from Ali, he is trying to be positive! Fuller length ball on off, he dances down the track and whips it to the right of the man at mid on. They take a couple.
Full pitched delivery from Murtagh and driven by Ali down the track. The ball rolls on and hits the wickets at the other end.
